stories.headline: Meta's Muse AI can now organize your saved Instagram posts for you
stories.blurb: Instagram users can now chat with Muse directly in DMs to get context on posts, turn recipe videos into grocery lists, or organize saved content into custom folders. You can share posts with Muse and ask it to add restaurants to travel plans or find deals on products you've seen.
stories.why_it_matters: AI assistants are moving from separate apps into the places you already spend time.
stories.original_headline: Meta brings its Muse AI assistant directly into Instagram DMs

stories.headline: Tidal will delete 29 million AI-generated songs next month
stories.blurb: The streaming service is banning AI music outright on December 9th after labeling attempts failed. AI tracks made up 43% of new uploads in the last 90 days, but 96% of them got zero plays. Tidal will reject an estimated 80,000-85,000 AI tracks daily going forward.
stories.why_it_matters: First major streaming platform to ban AI music entirely, not just label or demote it.
stories.original_headline: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month

stories.headline: DeepMind's AI agents just made quantum computers 12× more efficient
stories.blurb: Teams of Gemini 4 agents competed to optimize quantum algorithms for fusion energy and drug design, cutting computing costs by nearly 12× through collaborative problem-solving and formal proof. The agents met every four hours to trade ideas, gradually reducing the resources needed to run simulations that today's quantum hardware can't yet handle.
stories.why_it_matters: AI is now solving the bottleneck that keeps quantum computers from tackling real problems.
stories.original_headline: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification

stories.headline: OpenAI's models now run the manager that trains your support bots
stories.blurb: Richpanel built an AI manager called Boss AI that sets up customer support agents automatically—writing procedures, connecting tools, and configuring workflows that used to require a dedicated engineer. It uses GPT-6 Astra and Sol for setup accuracy, then GPT-6 Luna for the actual customer conversations. Companies are automating half their support tickets in a month.
stories.why_it_matters: AI agents are now deploying other AI agents, eliminating the engineering bottleneck in automation.
stories.original_headline: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days

stories.headline: Hackers' AI agents just found and exploited a zero-day on their own
stories.blurb: Amazon says attackers used Cairn, an open-source pentesting framework, to autonomously discover and exploit a vulnerability in a medical imaging app—no human help beyond 'get root access.' The same AI tool built for defenders breached at least 10 organizations, exposed over 1 million records, and created persistent admin accounts.
stories.why_it_matters: Offensive AI agents are already operating at machine speed with minimal human oversight.
stories.original_headline: Amazon says hackers' AI agents found and exploited 0-day with little human input

try_this_prompt.title: The strategy translator
try_this_prompt.prompt: I'll describe a strategy or goal we've set. Translate it into three concrete decisions: one thing we'll stop doing, one thing we'll start saying no to, and one resource we'll move this quarter. If the strategy doesn't change any of those three things, tell me it's not actually a strategy.
try_this_prompt.tool_hint: When the roadmap sounds impressive but nothing's different on Monday.
